content.text: Put the yellow circle inside the blue box. Do not alter them.

The yellow circle has been successfully moved inside the blue box. The circle is now centered within the blue box, fitting nicely inside it without being altered (same size and shape).

The task is complete. The yellow circle is now placed inside the blue box, centered nicely within it.

- The blue box is unchanged in size and color
